proof -

  proof -
    fix s p n q
    assume clear: "ps_clear p n s" and al: "is_aligned p n" and mem: "q \<in> dom (ksPSpace s)" and lt: "p < q"
    show "\<not> q - p < (2::word32)^n"
    proof
      assume less: "q - p < (2::word32)^n"
      have le: "q \<le> p + 2^n - 1"
        using word_plus_mono_right[OF word_le_minus_one_leq[OF less] is_aligned_no_overflow'[OF al]] by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have inside: "q \<in> ({p .. p + 2^n - 1} - {p}) \<inter> dom (ksPSpace s)"
        using mem lt le by (simp add: atLeastAtMost_iff less_imp_le)
      show False using clear inside by (simp add: ps_clear_def shiftl_t2n)
    qed
  qed
  have min_gap: "\<And>s p n. \<lbrakk>ps_clear p n s; is_aligned p n; {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). p < k} \<noteq> {}\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<not> Min {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). p < k} - p < (2::word32)^n"

      by (rule Min_in[OF finite_class.finite ne])
    show "\<not> Min {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). p < k} - p < (2::word32)^n"
      using gap[OF c a] m by blast
  qed
  have get: "\<And>s ep. \<lbrakk>ksPSpace s p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep)); is_aligned p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep))); ps_clear p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep))) s\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> getObject p s = ({(ep,s)},False)"
    using min_gap
    apply (simp add: objBits_def getObject_def lookupAround2_def lookupAround_def psMap_def Let_def loadObject_asidpool loadObject_default_def projectKO_def projectKO_opts_defs alignCheck_def magnitudeCheck_def maybeToMonad_def maybe_def gets_def get_def bind_def return_def assert_def when_def unless_def is_aligned_mask)

  proof -
    fix s s' ep
    assume sr: "(s,s') \<in> state_relation" and kh: "kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep))" and al: "pspace_aligned' s'" and di: "pspace_distinct' s'"
    have ps: "pspace_relation (kheap s) (ksPSpace s')" using sr by (simp add: state_relation_def)
    have dp: "p \<in> pspace_dom (kheap s)"
      unfolding pspace_dom_def
      apply (rule UN_I[where a=p])
      using kh by (auto simp: dom_def)
    have d: "p \<in> dom (ksPSpace s')"
      using ps dp by (simp add: pspace_relation_def)
    obtain ko where ko: "ksPSpace s' p = Some ko" using d by auto
    have rr: "\<forall>x\<in>dom (kheap s). \<forall>(y,P)\<in>obj_relation_cuts (the (kheap s x)) x. P (the (kheap s x)) (the (ksPSpace s' y))"
      using ps by (simp add: pspace_relation_def)
    have r: "other_obj_relation (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)) ko"
      using rr[rule_format, of p "(p,other_obj_relation)"] kh ko by (auto simp: dom_def)
    have k: "\<exists>ep'. ko = KOArch (KOASIDPool ep')"

      subgoal for ao by (cases ao; auto)
      done
    show "\<exists>ep'. ksPSpace s' p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep')) \<and> is_aligned p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) \<and> ps_clear p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) s'"
      using k ko al[unfolded pspace_aligned'_def, rule_format, OF d] di[unfolded pspace_distinct'_def, rule_format, OF d] by auto
  qed
  have rel: "\<And>s s' ep ep'. \<lbrakk>(s,s') \<in> state_relation; kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)); ksPSpace s' p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> asid_pool_relation ep ep'"
  proof -
    fix s s' ep ep'
    assume sr: "(s,s') \<in> state_relation" and kh: "kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep))" and ch: "ksPSpace s' p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))"

    have rr: "\<forall>x\<in>dom (kheap s). \<forall>(y,P)\<in>obj_relation_cuts (the (kheap s x)) x. P (the (kheap s x)) (the (ksPSpace s' y))"
      using ps by (simp add: pspace_relation_def)
    have "other_obj_relation (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)) (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))"
      using rr[rule_format, of p "(p,other_obj_relation)"] kh ch by (auto simp: dom_def)
    then show "asid_pool_relation ep ep'" by (simp add: other_obj_relation_def)
  qed
  have aget: "\<And>s ep. kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)) \<Longrightarrow> get_asid_pool p s = ({(ep,s)},False)"
    by (simp add: get_asid_pool_def get_arch_obj_def get_object_def gets_def get_def bind_def return_def assert_def partial_inv_def a_type_def)
  show ?thesis using abs con rel get aget by (fastforce simp: corres_underlying_def asid_pool_relation_def)
qed

proof -
  have ex: "\<And>n. (\<exists>v::invocation_label. fromEnum v = n) = (n \<le> fromEnum (maxBound::invocation_label))"
  proof
    fix n
    assume "\<exists>v::invocation_label. fromEnum v = n"
    then obtain v :: invocation_label where "fromEnum v = n" by blast
    then show "n \<le> fromEnum (maxBound::invocation_label)" using maxBound_is_bound[of v] by simp
  next
    fix n
    assume "n \<le> fromEnum (maxBound::invocation_label)"
    then have "fromEnum (toEnum n :: invocation_label) = n" by (rule from_to_enum)
    then show "\<exists>v::invocation_label. fromEnum v = n" by blast
  qed
  have labels: "gen_invocation_type label = genInvocationType label"
    by (simp add: gen_invocation_type_def genInvocationType_def invocation_type_def invocationType_def data_to_nat_def Let_def ex)
  assume r: "list_all2 cap_relation (map fst caps) (map fst caps')"
  assume sl: "list_all2 (\<lambda>p pa. snd pa = cte_map (snd p)) caps caps'"
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases caps)
    case Nil
    then have cs: "caps' = []" using r by simp
    show ?thesis using Nil cs labels
      by (cases "genInvocationType label"; auto simp: decode_irq_handler_invocation_def decodeIRQHandlerInvocation_def corres_underlying_def returnOk_def throwError_def return_def dc_def)
  next
    case (Cons x xs)
    obtain c p where xp: "x = (c,p)" by (cases x)
    obtain c' p' ys where cs: "caps' = (c',p')#ys" and cp: "cap_relation c c'" and pp: "p' = cte_map p"
      using r sl Cons xp by (cases caps'; auto)
    show ?thesis using Cons xp cs cp pp labels
      by (cases "genInvocationType label"; cases c; auto simp: decode_irq_handler_invocation_def decodeIRQHandlerInvocation_def Let_def corres_underlying_def returnOk_def throwError_def return_def dc_def split: bool.splits)
  qed
qed
